scope: Task010 preparation only. Keys refer to app/ui/qt/strings.py SR and app/i18n STRINGS.sr_Latn. English intents are editorial notes for Task012, never loaded by the application. Serbian source remains in those catalogs. Paths, enum values and database identifiers are not translations.

english_intents.quarantine_description: Select a history entry and review its restore plan before confirming.
english_intents.quarantine_empty_detail: Moved photographs appear here and can be restored through an approved plan.
english_intents.history_selection: Operation, source, destination, and eligibility for preparation; the service rechecks file and destination.
english_intents.history_load_failed: History is unavailable; restoring is disabled. Technical details are available on request.
english_intents.quarantine_preview_unavailable: No verifiable quarantine file exists for this entry.
english_intents.quarantine_content_changed: The quarantine file no longer matches its recorded identity and content.
english_intents.quarantine_folder_unavailable: Quarantine folder unavailable; check the drive connection.
english_intents.folder_open_failed: The operating system could not open the selected quarantine folder.
english_intents.settings_appearance_detail: Theme applies across all pages and dialogs and is saved immediately.
english_intents.matching_explanation: Thresholds find VISUAL candidates, not proven duplicates; higher values can include edits and other captures. Presets are not quality-calibrated.
english_intents.matching_strict_detail: pHash 2 / dHash 3: narrower search may miss candidates and still produce false matches.
english_intents.matching_balanced_detail: pHash 4 / dHash 6: existing defaults; every VISUAL candidate requires review.
english_intents.matching_broader_detail: pHash 8 / dHash 10: broader search may produce more false candidates; review carefully.
english_intents.matching_custom_detail: Custom thresholds remain saved; 0–64 values affect false matches, not quality ratings.
english_intents.settings_safety_detail: Quarantine is reversible movement inside the source root, with preparation, confirmation and restart recovery. Do not manually move files or erase recovery data.
english_intents.preview_cache_detail: The 64 MiB preview LRU is an in-memory budget, not disk use or measured usage. Decoding may temporarily use more; history thumbnails are not cached. Recovery data is separate and persistent.
english_intents.storage_info: Actual active index path and physical photo count, excluding missing/moved files; disconnected drives remain recorded.
english_intents.storage_failed: Index information unavailable. Open technical details.
english_intents.offline_detail: Local and offline; no cloud, accounts, telemetry or external AI APIs.
english_intents.review_session_only: Review choices last until closing or rescanning and are not the operation journal.
english_intents.query_error: Results unavailable. Retry or open technical details.
english_intents.choose_keeper: Choose which photograph to retain. Moving needs separate confirmation.
english_intents.review_advice: Preserve valuable versions. Similarity needs manual review; quarantine needs separate confirmation.
english_intents.direct_members: Direct group candidates and member pages
english_intents.member_count: Photographs in this direct group; browse members
english_intents.selection_summary: Counts proposed for quarantine and explicitly retained
english_intents.selection_limit: Review at most 200 photographs per plan; finish or clear the selection.
english_intents.both_kept: Both photographs retained. Quarantine proposal cleared.
english_intents.photo_summary: Filename, format, pixel dimensions and readable file size
english_intents.plan_summary: Confirmation and number of photographs to move
english_intents.plan_reversible: Quarantine is reversible. Restoring requires new preparation and confirmation; existing files are never overwritten.
english_intents.operation_count: Number successfully moved; refreshing results and history
english_intents.whole_index: Entire local index, counting physical files
english_intents.exact_space_detail: Unique physical EXACT copies, excluding retained originals
english_intents.first_scan_detail: Add folders or drives. PhotoAgent searches locally and preserves originals.
english_intents.recent_scan_summary: Time and status; processed photographs, EXACT candidates, VISUAL links and failures
english_intents.no_matches_detail: Add more sources or start another scan.
english_intents.source_description: Add sources in review order. Originals remain unchanged.
english_intents.empty_sources: No sources yet. Add the first folder to begin.
english_intents.source_priority: Source order influences retained-file recommendations. Select a source and move it up/down. Another-drive copies may be deliberate backups.
english_intents.scan_result_summary: Status, photograph count, EXACT groups, possible VISUAL links and failures
english_intents.scan_failure_help: Check source availability and free space for the local index, then retry. Details below.
english_intents.design_system_note: Style preview without photographs or collection data
english_intents.title: PhotoAgent · local photograph review
english_intents.dashboard_purpose: Local collection and latest scan status.
english_intents.scan_purpose: Choose sources and scan without changing originals.
english_intents.duplicates_purpose: Review direct groups/candidates; choices last only for this session.
english_intents.compare_purpose: Review the pair and choose the photograph to retain.
english_intents.history_purpose: Review quarantine history and prepare a safe restore.
english_intents.settings_purpose: Choose appearance and sensitivity for the next scan.
english_intents.name: Name
english_intents.selected_move: Prepare quarantine for the selected pair
english_intents.bulk_move: Prepare all eligible EXACT copies across this session
english_intents.unimplemented: Detection unavailable for this category; only EXACT and VISUAL are supported.
english_intents.page: First–last row and total row count
english_intents.groups: Direct groups: retained photograph and candidates
english_intents.group: Classification, member count and retained path
english_intents.language_later: Language switching comes in a later milestone.
english_intents.sensitivity: Advanced sensitivity for the next scan
english_intents.locked: Locked protection: plan confirmation, RAW/XMP safeguards, SHA-256, no overwrite or permanent deletion. Aspect threshold 0.025.
english_intents.settings_roots: Edit default roots on Scan. Ordering affects retained-file recommendations.
english_intents.index_info: Index path; maximum 64 MiB preview cache with process-isolated decoding
english_intents.preview_note: Preview downscaled to 2048 px; 100% refers to preview pixels.
english_intents.heuristic: Recommendation uses RAW, resolution, format and size. Focus, noise and editing history are not measured; RAW does not replace edited JPEG automatically.
english_intents.metadata: Full path, format, dimensions, bytes, SHA-256, RAW status and unknown editing history
english_intents.cross_roots: Different roots: copies may be deliberate backups.
english_intents.xmp_possible: XMP protection is checked when preparing the plan. Sidecars remain in place.
english_intents.visual_warning: VISUAL similarity is not proof of duplication; other captures or edits are possible.
english_intents.plan_move: Technical action, classification, source/destination, SHA-256 and identity
english_intents.raw_prompt: Type the exact technical token RAW to approve a RAW operation
english_intents.legacy_confirm: I confirm restoring current bytes from legacy history.
english_intents.no_plan: No eligible candidates. Bulk requires decoded same-root EXACT pairs without RAW or XMP.
english_intents.error: Action unfinished. Review details and retry after resolving the cause.
english_intents.closing: Waiting for jobs to finish safely…
english_intents.report_error: Scan saved, but CSV report could not be created. Technical details available.
english_intents.dashboard_counts: Indexed photographs, EXACT candidates, direct VISUAL links and potential EXACT bytes
english_intents.estimate: Estimate is not approval. Same-drive quarantine does not free disk space.
english_intents.last_scan: Latest session ID, status, date and error count
english_intents.candidate_changed_review_again: Photograph changed; scan and review again.
english_intents.incomplete_scan: Incomplete scan; scan again before moving files.
english_intents.root_or_volume_changed: Source or drive changed; check connection and review again.
english_intents.recovery_blocked: Earlier operation recovery needs review of details.
english_intents.empty_plan: No eligible operations in the plan.
english_intents.unavailable_source: One or more sources are unavailable; check drive connections.
english_intents.action_cancelled: Action cancelled. Earlier operation journal retained.
english_intents.message_unavailable: Message unavailable. Open technical details or retry.
english_intents.keyboard_groups: Use arrows to select a group and Enter to open comparison.
english_intents.keyboard_pairs: Use arrows to select a pair and Enter to open comparison.
english_intents.keyboard_sources: Use arrows to select a source; change priority in the advanced section.
english_intents.keyboard_history: Use arrows to select a photograph, then Restore photograph to review its plan.
english_intents.selected_group: Selected, followed by the group name
english_intents.keep_named_photo: Keep this photograph, followed by its full path
english_intents.keep_description: Selection only prepares a proposal. Moving requires plan review and confirmation.
english_intents.quarantine_description_action: Opens plan preview. Movement needs separate explicit confirmation.
english_intents.restore_description_action: Opens the selected photograph's restore plan; existing files are never overwritten.
english_intents.plan_paths: Photographs and locations in the plan
english_intents.scan_review_only: Incomplete results are review-only. Complete a successful scan before moving files.
english_intents.page_count: Showing up to the indicated result out of the total
english_intents.index_warning: Temporary or incomplete index with details
english_intents.operation_error: Operation stopped. Journal preserved; recover before another operation.
english_intents.history_error: History unavailable. Scanning allowed, moves/restores blocked.
english_intents.xmp_warning: XMP sidecars found. They remain in place; review their relationship to the photograph.
english_intents.legacy_warning: Legacy history cannot verify earlier content. Confirm current bytes individually.
